answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 21739 Country: India Title: Assalam o alikum wa rehmatullah wa barakatuh. Is awoman can perform HAJJ alone or (without Mahram)your reply is awaited. Jazakumullah. Question: Assalam o alikum wa rehmatullah wa barakatuh. Is awoman can perform HAJJ alone or (without Mahram)your reply is awaited. Jazakumullah. Answer ID: 21739 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 618/618/M=1431) If a woman performs the hajj rituals alone, her hajj shall be valid, however for a woman it is unlawful and sin to travel without husband or mahram. Yes, if the woman is present in Makkah then she can perform the hajj rituals alone, but the company of husband or mahram is better. ثم المحرم أو الزوج إنما يشترط إذا كان بين المرأة و بين مكة ثلثة أيام فصاعداًفإن كان إقل من ذلك حجت بغير محرم الخ . (بدائع). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
